note: What a server sends to break off an attack a unit is making. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The missile the attack would have thrown, where there is one.

bits.name: keepAnimating
bits.note: Set to let the attack's animation play on after the stop.

bits.name: forceCast
bits.note: Set to make the attack land first where it has not already.

bits.name: forceStop
bits.note: Set to stop the attack outright; a client does so anyway where it cannot see the unit, and keepAnimating and forceCast then have no effect.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot stopped is a summoner spell's.

bits.name: destroyMissile
bits.note: Set to destroy the missile named in missile, where it exists; forced, after the attack landed, the spell's cooldown is also refunded.

bits.name: completeCast
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

revisions.note: Whatever the flags, a client then clears the unit's attack.

bits.name: keepAnimating
bits.note: Set where the unit finishes what it was doing to look at.

bits.name: finishSwing
bits.note: Set where a swing not yet let go is let go before it stops.

bits.name: forced
bits.note: Set to stop what the unit is casting at once, whether or not it would otherwise stop.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where what is broken off came from a summoner slot.

bits.name: destroyMissile
bits.note: Set where the missile named below is to go too.
